questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Dinosaur : Reptile ∷ Granite : ?
questions.solution:
Dinosaur : Reptile → Dinosaur belongs to the class reptile or, dinosaur is categorised as reptile.

Similarly,

Granite : ? → Granite belongs to the class stone, or granite is categorised as stone.

Hence, ‘stone’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: ‘Height’ is related to ‘Meters’ in the same way as ‘Weight’ is related to ‘_________’.
questions.solution:
‘Height’ is related to ‘Meters’ → Height is measured in meters.

Similarly,

‘Weight’ is related to ‘_________’ → Weight is measured in kilograms.

Hence, ‘kilogram’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed be two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No monkey is baboon.

All baboons are donkeys.

**Conclusions:**

I. No donkey is monkey.

II. Some donkeys are baboons.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows
Both conclusion I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bb64eed2ddbca6e1f01bb7715248f325211120957501fba3623a32f8128263e.png] 

I. No donkey is monkey. → False (Because, only those part of Donkey that is Baboons are not Monkey, but no definite relation given between all Donkeys and Monkey, so it can be possible only).

II. Some donkeys are baboons. → True (Because, All Baboons are Donkeys gives some Donkeys are Baboons definitely).

Hence, only conclusion II follows.

questions.question: If G = 7, and SHORT = 8, then how will you code FEAT?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e364f39ec5ab4e4a033d423e608bf1e8a1eb03483a0ad0fe11fd6c8faf32c44.png] 

Given G = 7 → 7 + 0 = 7

SHORT = 16 → 19 + 8 + 15 + 18 + 20 = 80

8 + 0 = 8

Similarly,

FEAT = ? → 6 + 5 + 1 + 20 = 32

? = 3 + 2 = 5

Hence, ‘5’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which one set of letters when sequentially placed at the gaps in the given letter series shall complete it?

I_mm_n I I_m _n I_mm n_

options.text: I n m n I n
I n m n I m
I m m n I n
n m n I n I

questions.solution:
Given series: I_mm_n I I_m _n I_mm n_

Dividing the series into three parts, we see a general pattern in maintained in every single part and the same is repeated.

(l **l **m m **n** n)/ (l l **m** m **n** n) / (l **l** m m n **n**)

Hence, ‘I n m n I n’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

7 : 52 ∷ 11 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic is:

7 : 52 → 7 : 7² + 3

Similarly,

11 : ? → 11 : 11² + 3

? = 121 + 3 = 124

Hence, ‘124’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given mathematical equation correct?

24 ÷ 4 - 18 + 2 × 5 = 14
questions.solution:
1) ÷ and ×

Given equation: 24 ÷ 4 - 18 + 2 × 5 = 14

After interchanging ‘÷ and ×’, we get:

L.H.S = 24 × 4 - 18 + 2 ÷ 5

= 96 - 18 + 0.4

= 96.04 - 18

= 78.4 ≠ R.H.S

2) × and +

Given equation: 24 ÷ 4 - 18 + 2 × 5 = 14

After interchanging ‘× and +’, we get:

L.H.S = 24 ÷ 4 - 18 × 2 + 5

= 6 - 36 + 5

= 11 - 36</p&g
